title: Samsung Health
body:
I have been using Samsung Health App for more than 15 years and it helped me tremendously to recover my health and physical condition at an optimal level! 
Using this app in 6 months I succeeded to improve my health conditions and in one year a lost about 16 kilograms!
I am 73 and 7 months and I fill except.
What you need is to be motivated and not give up from your own objectives!

title: Blood pressure and EKG missing
body:
Tensiune arteriala si Ekg pentru utilizatorii Iphone si ceasuri Samsung,va rugam! Este 1 an de la ultima versiune,introduceti functiile care lipsesc deoarece IOS nu va limiteaza cu nimic pentru introducerea TA si EKG. Utilizatorii de Iphone care au cumparat produsele Samsung au platit pret intreg,pentru a beneficia de toate functiile produsului respectiv,pentru design sau pentru ca sunt usor mai accesibile! Actualizati aplicatiile va rugam si adaugati functiile care lipsesc! Nu ne am cerut scuze cand am cumparat si nici nu ne-ati cerut mai putini bani pentru lipsa functiilor din aplicatii, Noi am cumparat produsul nu aplicatia,asa ca puneti la dispozitie compatibilitate deplina,daca tot ați spus ca un produs Samsung este compatibil IOS,nu ne da-ti firimituri!
EKG and Blood pressure please for IPhone user!!
O zi frumoasa!

body:
You probably need to look at the competitors (like Fitbit) and revise the app.
Maybe its because im using an iPhone but the app seems very poorly made.
In the sleep data tab doesn’t sync with my watch although its on auto sync.
I was expecting a bit more user experience from Samsung, but i’m dissapoited in this category.
Why can’t you merge the 2 apps( health and galaxy fit)? Its stupid to have 2 apps for one use. 
That’s why competitors win more over you, from my user perspective.
